LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_KnifeStab.label: knife stab
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_KnifeStab.description: A fast, level thrust with the knife and a quick pull back to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_KnifeSlash.label: knife slash
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_KnifeSlash.description: A short, fast wrist slash across the target and back to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SwordCut.label: sword cut
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SwordCut.description: A sharp diagonal cut from high behind the shoulder, followed by a long eased return to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SwordThrust.label: sword thrust
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SwordThrust.description: A quick, level thrust with the point driven straight at the target, then drawn back to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_GreatswordCut.label: greatsword cut
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_GreatswordCut.description: A heavy two-handed cut from far over the shoulder, followed by a slow haul back to rest.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_GreatswordSweep.label: greatsword sweep
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_GreatswordSweep.descripti: A wide, flat two-handed sweep carried around the body and across the target.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SpearThrust.label: spear thrust
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SpearThrust.description: The spear is levelled and driven hard to full reach, then drawn back along the shaft.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SpearThrustLow.label: low spear thrust
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_SpearThrustLow.descriptio: A crouched spear thrust driven low at the legs, then drawn back to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_AxeChop.label: axe chop
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_AxeChop.description: An overhead chop brought down hard that sticks for a beat before the axe is worked free.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ClubSwing.label: club swing
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ClubSwing.description: A round swing from the shoulder that lands hard and is dragged back to rest.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ClubBackhand.label: club backhand
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ClubBackhand.description: A reverse arc where the club dips low, then whips up and across before settling.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_MaulSwing.label: maul swing
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_MaulSwing.description: A two-handed overhead smash with a hanging wind-up, a ground-shaking drop and a slow recovery.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Jab.label: jab
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Jab.description: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, snapped out and back.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Cross.label: cross
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Cross.description: A heavy rear-hand punch with the hips turning in behind it.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ToolSwing.label: tool swing
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_ToolSwing.description: A committed swing with whatever is in hand, followed by a return to rest.
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Flinch.label: flinch
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Flinch.description: A small, sharp snap away from a light blow, then the pawn settles back.
LanguageData.Flourish_React_FlinchHard.label: heavy flinch
LanguageData.Flourish_React_FlinchHard.description: The pawn is knocked back hard by a heavy blow, freezes for a beat, then rebounds.
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Sidestep.label: sidestep
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Sidestep.description: A snap step back and to the side out of the blow's line, held, then an eased return.
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Duck.label: duck
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Duck.description: A quick squashed duck under incoming fire, held briefly, then the pawn straightens up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Blade.label: blade parry
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Blade.description: The defender snaps the blade across the line and the attacker's weapon is knocked back with a hard clash.
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Polearm.label: polearm parry
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Polearm.description: The defender whips the shaft up across the line and the attacker's blow is knocked back with a hard clash.
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Blunt.label: blunt parry
LanguageData.Flourish_Parry_Blunt.description: The defender braces and takes the blow on the weapon, and the attacker bounces off hard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Critical.label: critical follow-through
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Critical.description: After a big hit the weapon drives on through, then snaps back up into guard with a flourish.
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Draw.label: melee draw
LanguageData.Flourish_Melee_Draw.description: The weapon is spun once and snapped into guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Dash.label: dash launch
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Dash.description: A hard crouch and a drive forward, grit thrown back off the push-off foot and the air torn into speed lines.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Leap.label: leap launch
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Leap.description: The legs load deep and the pawn goes up, a ring of dust blown off the spot they left.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Roll.label: roll
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Roll.description: The pawn drops low and throws themselves forward over the shoulder, grit scattering as they come up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Vault.label: vault
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Vault.description: A step, a hard plant, and the body springs up and over with speed lines trailing.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Charge.label: charge
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Charge.description: The pawn drops a shoulder and drives forward off the back foot, dust torn up behind them and the air in streaks.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Strike.label: physical strike
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Strike.description: A short hard wind-up and a committed blow, a smear through the arc and a flash on contact.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Brace.label: brace
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Brace.description: The pawn slams their feet down and sets themselves, weight driven into the ground in a ring of dust.
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Effort.label: physical effort
LanguageData.Flourish_Phys_Effort.description: A short braced effort, weight dropping and driving back up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Landing_Soft.label: touchdown
LanguageData.Flourish_Landing_Soft.description: The knees give on landing with a scuff of grit, and the pawn springs back up straight.
LanguageData.Flourish_Landing_Heavy.label: heavy touchdown
LanguageData.Flourish_Landing_Heavy.description: A hard arrival: a deep squash, a starburst and a frozen beat of impact, a ring of dust thrown out and the ground cracked under the boots.
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Downed.label: downed collapse
LanguageData.Flourish_React_Downed.description: The body drops hard onto the ground, flattening on impact in a ring of dust and a cracked patch of earth.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Bolt.label: bolt precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Bolt.description: The caster coils back as psychic light collapses into the hands, then snaps forward and a zigzag bolt leaves them.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Nova.label: nova precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Nova.description: The caster crushes down around a collapsing ring, then bursts upright as a hard psychic ring tears outward across the ground.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Conjure.label: conjure precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Conjure.description: A rune ellipse opens underfoot as the caster raises and coils, then slams forward and a column of light brings the summoning up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Ward.label: ward precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Ward.description: A rune ellipse opens underfoot as the caster braces, then snaps upright with the weapon raised and holds while a hard ring seals the ward.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Beam.label: beam precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Beam.description: Light collapses into the hands as the caster coils, then they snap forward and hold the stretch while a cone of psychic lines runs out ahead.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Touch.label: touch precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Touch.description: A short coil around a small collapsing ring, then a committed step in and a psychic starburst at the point of contact.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Channel.label: channel precast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Channel.description: Power collapses into the caster in two long pulls as they sink and compress, then bursts back out as they spring upright.
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Skip.label: skip cast
LanguageData.Flourish_Cast_Skip.description: A collapsing ring and a hard crouch, then a snap upward as the air splits in a vertical slit and a psychic ring cracks outward.
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawPistol.label: pistol draw
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawPistol.description: The sidearm snaps up from the hip to a ready carry.
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawLong.label: long gun draw
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawLong.description: The long gun snaps up from a low carry into the shoulder.
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawBow.label: bow draw
LanguageData.Flourish_Ranged_DrawBow.description: The bow snaps up from a low carry to the ready.
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Pistol.label: pistol aim
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Pistol.description: The pistol snaps up from the carry onto the target line and the shooter leans in.
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Long.label: shoulder aim
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Long.description: The long gun snaps up from the low carry onto the target line as the shooter leans into the stock.
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Bow.label: bow draw and aim
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Bow.description: The bow comes up onto the line and the archer leans back into a full draw, held until the loose.
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Thrown.label: throw wind-up
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Thrown.description: The arm cocks back behind the shoulder, holds, then whips forward into the throw.
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Scoped.label: scoped hold
LanguageData.Flourish_Aim_Scoped.description: The rifle snaps onto the line, then the shooter goes still on the scope with only a breath of movement.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Pistol.label: pistol shot
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Pistol.description: The pistol barks and flips up on a light wrist kick, then drops back onto the line.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Rifle.label: rifle shot
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Rifle.description: A single round punches the rifle back into the shoulder before it settles onto the line.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Charge.label: charge shot
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Charge.description: A charged bolt leaves the weapon on a heavy shove that the shooter rides back onto the line.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Minigun.label: heavy gun shot
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Minigun.description: A single heavy round slams the whole body back before the gun is wrestled onto the line.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Bolt.label: bolt cycle
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Bolt.description: The rifle kicks hard, cants up while the bolt is worked and the case flies, then settles back onto the target.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Pump.label: pump rack
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Pump.description: The blast throws the shotgun up, the fore-end is racked back and slammed home with the shell flying, and it drops back onto the line.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Bow.label: bow release
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Bow.description: The string snaps, the bow rolls forward and dips in the follow-through, then comes back to the ready.
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Throw.label: throw
LanguageData.Flourish_Shot_Throw.description: The arm whips over the shoulder with a step into the throw and follows through.
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_Rifle.label: rifle burst
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_Rifle.description: The rifle climbs a notch on every round of the burst, then drops back onto the target.
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_SMG.label: submachine gun burst
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_SMG.description: The light gun chatters and climbs through a quick burst, then snaps back onto the target.
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_Minigun.label: minigun burst
LanguageData.Flourish_Burst_Minigun.description: The heavy gun shoves the shooter back and shudders upward through the long burst before it is hauled back down onto the target.
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Mag.label: magazine change
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Mag.description: The weapon cants in, the empty magazine drops, and a fresh one is slapped home before it snaps back up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Shells.label: shell reload
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Shells.description: The shotgun is turned in and shells are thumbed into the tube with a sharp push each, then it comes back up.
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_BoltRifle.label: rifle reload
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_BoltRifle.description: The rifle cants in, the magazine is swapped and slapped home, then the bolt is run to chamber a round.
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Belt.label: heavy reload
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Belt.description: The heavy weapon drops onto the hip, the spent feed falls away, and a fresh belt or cell is slammed in.
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Quiver.label: quiver reach
LanguageData.Flourish_Reload_Quiver.description: The bow dips while the archer reaches back and snaps a fresh arrow onto the string.
LanguageData.Flourish_RangedExec_Pistol.label: pistol execution
LanguageData.Flourish_RangedExec_Pistol.description: The shooter steps in and snaps the pistol level over a downed or broken enemy, who cowers from the muzzle.
LanguageData.Flourish_RangedExec_Long.label: long gun execution
LanguageData.Flourish_RangedExec_Long.description: The shooter closes the last step and snaps the long gun onto a downed or broken enemy from a few feet away.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Knife.label: knife execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Knife.description: A coil and a driving stab: the blade whips up and punches home, the victim snaps back and drops.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Sword.label: sword execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Sword.description: The blade snaps back over the shoulder and comes through in one bright crescent; the victim is thrown back and falls.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Greatsword.label: greatsword execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Greatsword.description: The greatsword hauled up and hung for a heartbeat, then brought down in one huge crescent that shakes the ground.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Spear.label: spear execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Spear.description: The spear cocked high at the shoulder and driven down and through in one punch; the victim is thrown back off the point and falls.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Axe.label: axe execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Axe.description: An overhead chop: the axe whips up behind the head and comes down through the shoulder in one hard crescent.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Club.label: club execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Club.description: An overhead crack to the head: the club whips over in a short crescent and the victim drops where they stand.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Maul.label: maul execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Maul.description: The maul hauled up and hung overhead on a stretch, then slammed down with the whole body; the ground cracks and rings with the victim.
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Fists.label: fists execution
LanguageData.Flourish_Exec_Fists.description: A snapping jab that rocks the victim, then a full-body hook that throws them back and down.
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Blades.label: blade duel
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Blades.description: Three hard exchanges: a cut slammed onto a raised guard, the answer met the same way, and a last cut beaten off before both settle.
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Polearms.label: polearm duel
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Polearms.description: Thrust, beat, thrust: a lunge knocked aside by a sweeping haft, the answer knocked aside the same way, and a last thrust beaten off before both reset.
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Blunt.label: blunt duel
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Blunt.description: A huge overhead swing slammed onto a braced haft, then the counter slammed down the same way; both come back to guard.
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Fists.label: fist duel
LanguageData.Flourish_Duel_Fists.description: A jab smacked onto the guard, a cross answered onto the other guard, a hook blocked; both reset their feet and square up.
